scope: Opt-in app welcome and profile flow
status: reviewed prototype; full v3.2 goal remains active

visualReview.method: Normal-speed browser recordings captured. Visual inspection covered 14 controlled timeline frames, recording contact sheets and both browser screenshots.
findings: The peek passes behind the logo before the character enters the foreground.
The welcome wave continues while one eye winks; the opposite eye responds to a later keyboard activation.
Rounded paw and envelope contact remain intact in the reviewed greeting samples.
Welcome content fades before form content appears, preventing readable text from sitting behind the moving character.
The character settles beside the form and moves clear of the fields when the keyboard viewport shrinks.
The 320 by 568 welcome keeps the primary action and closed profile selector in view.

verification.voice: simulated recognition and playback in regression checks

fixedDuringReview: Form content initially appeared before the large character had moved clear; reveal now follows the shared animation clock.
Profile selector text lacked contrast on the light welcome; the welcome now supplies its own surface colors.
An early Begin click could wait for image loading; the form now opens immediately until the guide has rendered.
Reduced-height welcome layout was tightened to keep the closed profile selector fully visible.
remaining: Home daily receipt and real card integration
Page-loading continuity between onboarding and the daily content
Final review of all 20 gestures with the shared transitions
Native iPhone performance and release verification
